art.meaning: The advisor's drawing. One vector master is the baseline; every size is made from it by scripts/build-advisor-avatar.mjs.

sizes.where: Timeline top centre on desktop and the Mac
Chat page, beside the page links

anchors.units: 1024 x 1024, the master's viewBox divided by 4

state.resting.meaning: Nothing waits for the person. The advisor is present and calm.
state.resting.when: No unopened brief, no unanswered question, check-in or tip, and the panel is closed.
state.resting.reads: useAdvisor(): hasNew is false and panelOpen is false
state.resting.motion: Slow breathing, one blink every few seconds, a light drift in the mane.

state.waiting.meaning: Something waits for the person: an unopened brief, an unanswered question, a check-in or a tip.
state.waiting.reads: useAdvisor(): hasNew is true; item.kind gives the reason (brief, proposal, check_in, notice, tip)
state.waiting.motion: Eye open wide, ears forward, calm between gestures. No dot, badge or pulsing ring: the label carries the count.
state.waiting.still: The plain drawing; the label reads "Advisor · 1 new".

state.trouble.meaning: The Daily Brief could not be prepared, or it hit a limit.
state.trouble.when: The brief shows a notice instead of advice.
state.trouble.motion: None. The head sits slightly lower and stays still. The notice's words explain what happened.

state.attending.meaning: The advisor panel is open and the person is reading or answering.
state.attending.motion: A slight lean toward the panel, slower blinks, the mane settles.

state.preparing.meaning: Cadence is preparing or refreshing today's Daily Brief.
state.preparing.motion: The eye narrows in focus, the mane moves faster and a thin arc spins around the circle (kept from the trial by the owner, November 21, 2026).
state.preparing.still: The plain drawing; the brief's own "preparing" words show progress.

state.working.meaning: Cadence is applying the person's answer: a brief move, a schedule answer or a tip reaction.
state.working.when: An answer was sent and its result has not come back.
state.working.reads: useAdvisor(): proposal.pending or tip.pending is set. A brief move in flight is not wired yet (follow-up).
state.working.motion: Focused eye and a short, quick mane movement until the result arrives.
state.working.still: The plain drawing; the answer links are disabled.

state.replying.meaning: Chat is reading the schedule or writing a reply.
state.replying.motion: Focused eye and a steady mane movement while the reply arrives.
state.replying.still: The plain drawing; Chat's own waiting line shows progress.

gesture.arrive.meaning: The advisor wakes when the person first opens the Timeline on a local day.
gesture.arrive.when: First Timeline open of the local day on this device.
gesture.arrive.motion: The eye opens and the avatar settles into place. The trial's enlarged entrance from the page centre is kept only as a test variant.

gesture.notice.meaning: Something new arrived for the person while the Timeline was open.
gesture.notice.when: hasNew changes from false to true.
gesture.notice.motion: One ear flick, a double blink and one gust through the mane. It plays once.
gesture.notice.still: No movement; the label changes to "Advisor · 1 new".
gesture.notice.fromTrial: advice (gust and double blink, played once instead of looping)

gesture.acknowledge.meaning: Cadence applied what the person answered.
gesture.acknowledge.when: An answer's outcome arrives: a move applied, a schedule change made, a tip saved as helpful.
gesture.acknowledge.still: No movement; the italic outcome line confirms it.

gesture.refused.meaning: Cadence could not apply the person's answer.
gesture.refused.when: An answer returns the "Not changed." line.
gesture.refused.motion: The ears tip back once and return.
gesture.refused.still: No movement; the red line explains it.
